title: Fees.
bodyText: Any person filing a foreign judgment shall pay $100 to the clerk of the court. Fees for docketing, transcription, or other enforcement proceedings shall be as provided by law for judgments of the court of this State.
bodyHtml: §636C-6  Fees.  Any person filing a foreign judgment shall pay $100 to the clerk of the court.  Fees for docketing, transcription, or other enforcement proceedings shall be as provided by law for judgments of the court of this State. [L 1983, c 31, pt of §1; am L 1998, c 128, §6]
